description.narrative: .This Project represents Phase II of an upgrading, revitalization and modernization project of the Kenya Industrial Research <(>&<)> Development Institute (KIRDI). Phase I, implemented between October 2008 and November 2009, focused primarily on capacity building of senior policy makers of the Government of Kenya and KIRDI#s top management, exposing them to various aspects of technology development <(>&<)> R <(>&<)>D institutions in India. It also provided them with insights into the scope of industrial development strategies in general and, in particular, to the technology requirements at KIRDI. This exposure led KIRDI to identify several strategic issues that were to be addressed immediately through an action plan to ensure improvements in enterprise productivity, competitiveness and growth, technology development and transfer, improvement of facilities and equipment, ICT, and human resource and quality management. Moreover, the Ministry of Industrialization (erstwhile Ministry of Trade and Industry) repeatedly requested UNIDO to provide the necessary technical support to bring in the best of technology practices elsewhere within the reach of UNIDO, for the benefit of Kenyan industries involved in delivering the envisaged 10% manufacturing growth rate per annum under the Nation#s Vi sion 2030.
